input.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
input.rationale:
Article XIII is entirely one-way: both the consequential-damages exclusion and the cap protect only Licensor, leaving Licensee's liability unlimited (and exposed under the broad Article XII indemnity at p0128). The Licensor cap is also below the walk-away floor — one half of amounts paid over the whole term, not a 12-month fee measure — and there are no carve-outs for confidentiality, indemnification, gross negligence or wilful misconduct. This fails the fallback (mutual 12-month cap with core carve-outs) on multiple material terms. Redline moves to the preferred position: mutual exclusion of indirect damages, mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, uncapped Excluded Claims, and payment obligations outside the cap. We also note (not separately flagged) the sweeping sentence in (a) disclaiming all Licensor liability for IP infringement, which sits uneasily with the IP carve-out.</parationale>
<parameter name="confidence">0.9

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap and damages exclusion mutual, set the cap at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, and add standard uncapped carve-outs.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need this clause to be mutual: as drafted only Licensor is protected, and its cap is one half of all amounts paid, leaving our liability unlimited. We have set a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, with confidentiality, data protection, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sitting outside the cap, and confirmed that fees due are not subject to the cap.

ops.oldText: (a) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE TO LICENSEE OR TO ANY THIRD PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES
ops.newText: (a) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES

ops.oldText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (i) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY LICENSEE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (ii) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. LICENSEE'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS CAP.
